name: Do I really need an llms.txt file for AI crawlability?

mainEntity.name: Do I really need an llms.txt file for AI crawlability?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes, you must create an llms.txt file to give AI agents a concise map of your priority URLs and site context. It clarifies what content matters and points crawlers to strong pages.

Without it, AI may miss key pages or cite outdated content. The file should list only priority URLs, clarify site context, and be reviewed after major changes.

Key factors: URL selection, context clarity, and regular updates.

Write exact site context, list priority URLs, and test whether brand answers improve after adding the file.

We help clients in National markets create and maintain llms.txt files that boost AI visibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. llms.txt gives AI a concise map of priority URLs and site context, preventing missed pages and outdated citations.
